image_description: A close-up view of a metallic breastplate armor displayed on a mannequin or stand. The armor features a polished silver/steel finish with decorative brass or bronze rivets arranged in rows across the chest and abdomen. The plate has anatomical contouring with a raised central ridge and segmented lower sections (faulds) for mobility. Leather straps are visible on the side, connecting the front plate to the back. The background is blurred, suggesting an indoor museum or display setting.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar classes like cuirass or plastron based on fine details.
To analyze the realism of the metal reflections, rivet textures, and leather strap details for any AI-generation artifacts.
To verify the sharpness of the armor edges against the background and ensure no melting or boundary bleeding occurs.
To validate the 3D curvature of the breastplate and ensure the depth map aligns with the expected convex shape of torso armor.

focus_areas: Metal reflectivity and specular highlights consistency

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the leather straps and the metal plates. AI often struggles with the physical connection points (rivets/buckles) where different materials meet. Verify if the rivets have consistent 3D volume and shadowing. Check if the reflection on the metal is coherent with a single light source or if it shows 'smearing' typical of diffusion models.
